summary: An April 1st joke RFC claiming that quantum entanglement will give some internet paths a round-trip time of zero seconds, a case protocol designers never expected, and warning of a bug worse than the millennium bug. It is humor, not a real problem report.

eli5.summary: A joke about messages arriving at the very same instant they are sent, which would confuse every computer. Made for April Fools' Day.
